title: Playing during the Depression of 1929-30
summary: He worked in a small orchestra with Joe and with all the city's brass bands.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: The Depression years and the WPA band

blocks.x: Where were you playing, by the way, when the Depression came? When the Depression hit in 1929?
Around 1929. Let's see. Orchestra or Brass Band?
Both of them. You want to turn it down? We can do it.
Yeah, turn it out. That's what I think that thing was hot to me. Yeah. That's my youngest sister, Dick. I think he might have to work, doesn't he?
Yeah, I believe so. Just pull that plug. We were talking about the Young Tuxedo and Depression. Which orchestra were you playing with when the Depression hit?

Well, in the Depression, me and Joe, we were in an orchestra. We had, you know, our little outfits. And then, like all musicians, just playing with anybody high, you know. You had everything you could. And the Brass Band? Brass Band was the same way. I worked with all the brass bands in the city that they had.
